pages.library: Embedded Coder Support Package for ARM Cortex-A Processors

fm.title: Arm cortex a
fm.description: Deployment blocks for ARM Cortex-A application processors running Linux or VxWorks (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Execute a subsystem as a Linux process task on an ARM Cortex-A processor — use to deploy algorithms as real-time Linux tasks on application processors
Execute a subsystem as a VxWorks task on an ARM Cortex-A processor — use when deploying to Cortex-A boards running VxWorks RTOS
Receive UDP datagrams on the ARM Cortex-A target — use for host-target communication over Ethernet during deployment
Send UDP datagrams from the ARM Cortex-A target — use for telemetry or parameter exchange with a host PC
